annotations.title: Guide: what to set up, and what is done

description: In a document that keeps the ledger: the places worth setting up, in order — reading statements and paychecks, making the list of categories yours, giving each merchant a category, the bills, the plan, the opening balance and the cushion — with which are done and what the document shows for each, and the tool that does each one. The same list and the same checks as the app’s Guide me. Call it after create_document, or when the user asks what is left to set up. Reads the document; changes nothing.
